title: He That Believes and Is Baptized
lyrics: All who believe and are baptized shall see the Lord's salvation; baptized into the death of Christ, they are a new creation. through Christ's redemption they shall stand among the glorious heav'nly band of every tribe and nation.

With one accord, O God, we pray grant us thy Holy Spirit; look thou on our infirmity through Jesus' blood and merit. Grant us to grow in grace each day that by this sacrament we may eternal life inherit.
artist: from Etlich Christlich Lider, Wittenberg, 1524, Kingo, Thomas Hansen (1634-1703)
alternateTitles: All Who Believe and Are Baptized
